## BigDecimal

Operands of *digits* decimal digits at working *precision*, so that
precision grows with the operands. libmpdec is the C library behind
CPython's `decimal`, timed without the interpreter. `round` drops the
low half of the operand; `parse` builds the value from its string.

Verified this run: decimo and libmpdec produce the same
2000-digit product from the same 1000-digit operands.

| Digits / precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | | CPython `decimal` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 9 / 28 | add | 44.9 ns | 35.0 ns | 1.28× slower | 46.2 ns | parity |
| 9 / 28 | subtract | 47.9 ns | 32.7 ns | 1.46× slower | 46.9 ns | parity |

## sqrt, exp, ln, power

A fixed set, chosen before the results were seen. `2.3456789`, and
`** 1.5` for power. 100 000 digits is left out because `mpd_exp`
needs 82 seconds there and `mpd_ln` 239 seconds.

| Precision | Operation | decimo | libmpdec | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 28 | sqrt | 2.68 µs | 897.1 ns | 2.98× slower |
| 28 | exp | 4.38 µs | 4.64 µs | **1.06× faster** |
| 28 | ln | 4.71 µs | 13.13 µs | **2.79× faster** |
| 28 | power | 11.27 µs | 35.71 µs | **3.17× faster** |
| 100 | sqrt | 4.25 µs | 4.20 µs | parity |
| 100 | exp | 10.20 µs | 15.18 µs | **1.49× faster** |
| 100 | ln | 72.29 µs | 39.52 µs | 1.83× slower |
| 100 | power | 93.52 µs | 81.85 µs | 1.14× slower |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 45.57 µs | 213.29 µs | **4.68× faster** |
| 1,000 | exp | 389.19 µs | 4.49 ms | **11.54× faster** |
| 1,000 | ln | 2.88 ms | 5.60 ms | **1.94× faster** |
| 1,000 | power | 3.35 ms | 11.26 ms | **3.36× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 1.22 ms | 22.57 ms | **18.44× faster** |
| 10,000 | exp | 56.55 ms | 1.404 s | **24.83× faster** |
| 10,000 | ln | 258.04 ms | 3.295 s | **12.77× faster** |
| 10,000 | power | 316.97 ms | 4.752 s | **14.99× faster** |

## BigInt against CPython's int

CPython's integers can only be reached through the interpreter, so
these include its overhead — read the large sizes as the real ones.
Division is 2n-by-n; two operands of the same width would give a
one-digit quotient and measure nothing.

| Digits | Operation | decimo | CPython `int` | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | add | 37.0 ns | 25.5 ns | 1.45× slower |
| 100 | multiply | 80.7 ns | 119.5 ns | **1.48× faster** |
| 100 | floor divide | 387.6 ns | 308.1 ns | 1.26× slower |
| 100 | sqrt | 485.2 ns | 319.4 ns | 1.52× slower |
| 1,000 | add | 52.6 ns | 93.6 ns | **1.78× faster** |
| 1,000 | multiply | 1.14 µs | 5.49 µs | **4.83× faster** |
| 1,000 | floor divide | 8.52 µs | 12.65 µs | **1.48× faster** |
| 1,000 | sqrt | 4.18 µs | 4.57 µs | **1.09× faster** |
| 10,000 | add | 270.0 ns | 784.4 ns | **2.91× faster** |
| 10,000 | multiply | 53.59 µs | 266.46 µs | **4.97× faster** |
| 10,000 | floor divide | 166.41 µs | 552.85 µs | **3.32× faster** |
| 10,000 | sqrt | 103.22 µs | 267.02 µs | **2.59× faster** |
| 100,000 | add | 2.65 µs | 7.80 µs | **2.94× faster** |
| 100,000 | multiply | 1.18 ms | 8.84 ms | **7.48× faster** |
| 100,000 | floor divide | 4.65 ms | 18.10 ms | **3.89× faster** |
| 100,000 | sqrt | 2.62 ms | 8.45 ms | **3.22× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | add | 27.00 µs | 80.96 µs | **3.00× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | multiply | 23.83 ms | 374.65 ms | **15.72× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | floor divide | 117.94 ms | 748.71 ms | **6.35× faster** |
| 1,000,000 | sqrt | 69.60 ms | 342.02 ms | **4.91× faster** |

## pi()

Each measurement in a fresh process, since mpmath and MPFR cache the
constant. Includes conversion to a decimal string, for every library.

| Digits | decimo | mpmath + GMP | MPFR | mpmath (pure Python) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 | 8.37 µs | 39.00 µs | 37.62 µs | 32.25 µs |
| 1,000 | 68.05 µs | 104.04 µs | 62.12 µs | 169.08 µs |
| 10,000 | 1.28 ms | 876.79 µs | 692.83 µs | 5.82 ms |
| 100,000 | 34.59 ms | 15.27 ms | 22.94 ms | 182.28 ms |
| 1,000,000 | 819.00 ms | 263.36 ms | 413.45 ms | 8.438 s |
